svg.aria-label: Flyer styled as a yellow San Francisco taxi with a TAXI EV roof sign. Through the window, the skyline and the Golden Gate at night while a cab drives by. SF Taxi goes electric: GPS traces from 466 San Francisco cabs turned into charging windows, energy demand and stop hotspots. The fare meter cycles through 466 cabs tracked, 30+ minute stops as charging windows and energy demand mapped.
